description: Unofficial agent-friendly mirror of szmeetups.com: Shenzhen meetups, language exchanges, shows & nightlife, exhibitions, festivals, sports and trade shows as structured data (events.json + RSS + ICS), updated daily. All event data (c) SZMeetups — always link back to the original event page.

for_agents.suggested_use: Fetch events_json daily; filter by your user's interests (categories), area and availability; remind about new matches and 3 days / 1 day before the start of events the user wants to attend. Recurring events carry next_occurrences. Always link the original event url on szmeetups.com; never invent events not in the data.

name: SZMeetups · Agent Mirror
